title: 落地了，就回家
logline: 深夜机场塔台，管制员苏青引导晚点三小时的老航班落地，发现机长是二十年前的飞行教官，专业术语的克制往来后，一句熟悉的称呼道出归家的温度。

shots.narrationZh: 夜风掠过跑道，灯串亮如星轨。
shots.narrationEn: Night wind sweeps the runway, light strings glow like star trails.
shots.visual: Night control tower, Su Qing in neat navy uniform with hair tied up and headset on sits before glowing radar screens, a coffee cup placed aside, distant runway lights twinkle through the circular window.
shots.ttsDirection: 沉静克制，语速平缓，气息沉稳，“夜”“星轨”重读，带深夜值守的倦意与专业氛围感

shots.visual: Su Qing picks up the microphone, her focused eyes fixed on the blinking delayed flight icon on the radar screen.

lines.zh: CCA1234，塔台呼叫，可以目视跑道。
lines.en: CCA1234, Tower calling, you are cleared for visual approach.

shots.ttsDirection: 专业专注，语速平稳，气息稳，重音落在管制指令关键词处，带高度集中的职业状态

shots.visual: In the cockpit, Captain Zhou Yuanhang in white uniform with four captain stripes, short black hair mixed with white, holds the intercom with a straight posture.

lines.zh: CCA1234，收到，已目视跑道，请求落地。
lines.en: CCA1234, roger, visual runway in sight, request landing.

shots.ttsDirection: 沉稳内敛，语速稍缓，气息微凝，重音落在应答指令处，藏住认出故人的隐晦波动

shots.narrationZh: CCA1234，风向270，风速5米，跑道02L，许可落地。
shots.narrationEn: CCA1234, wind 270 at 5 meters per second, runway 02L, cleared to land.
shots.visual: Su Qing speaks into the microphone, her expression focused, the communication panel in front of her lights up softly with status indicators.

lines.zh: CCA1234，风向270，风速5米，跑道02L，许可落地。
lines.en: CCA1234, wind 270 at 5 meters per second, runway 02L, cleared to land.

shots.ttsDirection: 克制冷静，语速平稳，气息稳，重音落在落地引导的关键指令处，压住未露的情绪

shots.narrationZh: 机轮触地，归家的路亮了。
shots.narrationEn: The wheels touch down, the road home lights up.
shots.visual: The plane touches down smoothly on the runway, runway lights streak past the cockpit windows, Su Qing takes off her headset with a faint relieved smile.
shots.ttsDirection: 舒缓释然，语速稍缓，气息轻扬，“归家”重读，带如释重负的暖意

shots.narrationZh: 周教官，落地了，回家好好休息。
shots.narrationEn: Instructor Zhou, you've landed, have a good rest on your way home.
shots.visual: Su Qing looks out the tower window at the taxiing plane, the soft brand slogan 'XX出行，陪你平安落地回家' appears at the bottom of the frame.

lines.zh: 周教官，落地了，回家好好休息。
lines.en: Instructor Zhou, you've landed, have a good rest on your way home.

shots.ttsDirection: 柔软怅然，语速放缓，气息柔，重音落在师生相关表述处，带藏了二十年的柔软情绪
